summary: Google Auth Backend Testing Complete - All 12 tests passed. POST /api/auth/google endpoint working correctly for new user creation, existing user lookup, JWT token generation, and admin panel visibility.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/auth/google endpoint correctly creates new users with firebase_uid, email, username, auth_provider=google
Endpoint correctly returns existing user when email or firebase_uid matches
Valid JWT tokens are generated with user_id and expiration
Google users appear in admin users list with all required fields
Handles missing email and displayName gracefully (generates username)
User lookup by email works even with different firebase_uid (important for account linking)
Token can be used for authenticated requests (/api/auth/me)
Frontend Login.js uses useRef for syncSocialAuth to avoid dependency issues
Firebase service uses signInWithRedirect for cross-origin compatibility
AuthContext properly stores token in localStorage and validates on load
seed_data_creation: Multiple test Google users created during testing (prefixed with test/new/existing/jwt/etc)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google auth backend fully tested. All endpoints working. Cannot test actual Firebase Google redirect in automation (requires real Google OAuth). Frontend code verified via code review - Login.js handles redirect result correctly.
